name: My Zypps - Ounce - GMO Nerds
description:
Sun-grown, full-bud, full ounce. The My Zypps GMO Nerds ounce delivers a full 28 grams of quality sun-grown flower — cured for full flavor and a smooth, even burn.

GMO Nerds pairs savory funk with candy sweetness: pungent garlic and earthy gas up front, cut with a bright, sugary fruit-candy finish.

28G sun-grown flower — full ounce of whole bud
Best value — full-ounce pricing at the lowest cost per gram
Signature GMO Nerds flavor — garlicky gas and earthy funk with a candy-sweet finish

My Zypps GMO Nerds is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
